title: VR Games Hub
description: A VR project featuring a 3D city environment and multiple mini-games developed in Unity. My contributions focused on the main environment layout, VR integration, and a mini-golf mini-game.

title: The Seeds
description: An environment-friendly maze game about gathering water and seeds to grow plants and clear a foggy map. Players use hiding spots and a gun to survive robot enemies that try to destroy the crops.
achievement: Top 5 projects at the Game Projects Exhibition (May 2026)

title: Masketeer
description: A 2D parallel-world dungeon crawler developed for Global Game Jam 2026. A mask lets the player switch worlds to navigate secret pathways, solve puzzles, and fight enemies.

title: Veil of Secrets
description: A 3D horror escape room game with puzzle mechanics, object interaction, an inventory system, NPC dialogues, health logic, lighting and VFX, and win/lose states.
achievement: 4th place at the departmental Game Projects Exhibition

title: Crimson Bastion
description: A 2D sci-fi platformer built for GameCon'25 at NED, with shooting mechanics, timed levels, collectibles, scoring, win/lose states, and integrated BGM/SFX. The Unity project is organized into clear scenes, scripts, prefabs, and assets.

title: Study Planner App
description: A study planner desktop application with a PyQt5 interface, flashcards for revision, notes, a to-do list, and chatbot functionality through API integration to help with study questions.

title: Maze Game (Tiny Triad)
description: My contribution to Tiny Triad, a C++ game suite: a maze mini-game built with data structures and algorithms such as DFS and hashing, featuring real-time scoring and a timing system.

title: Beaky Bounce
description: A flappy bird-inspired game designed and built in C++ using object-oriented programming concepts, with power-ups, collectible coins and gems, and multiple game screens.

title: Lipstick Commercial
description: A short lipstick commercial made in Adobe After Effects for the After Effects course I took at CEGA. It was my first After Effects project.
